description: This Java source file defines the ConditionalHeadersValidator class, which checks HTTP conditional headers related to ETags in commands. It performs validation based on given settings and predicates, throwing exceptions when conditions are not met.

classes.name: ConditionalHeadersValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates HTTP conditional headers (such as If-Match and If-None-Match) against a current entity tag, using configurable validation settings.

classes.name: ConditionalHeadersValidator.ValidationSettings
classes.description: An inner interface that provides methods to generate exceptions for failed precondition checks.

methods.name: ConditionalHeadersValidator.of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a validator with specified validation settings.

methods.name: ConditionalHeadersValidator.of (overloaded)
methods.description: Static factory method to create a validator with specified validation settings and an additional predicate to skip precondition checks.

methods.name: checkConditionalHeaders
methods.description: Validates the conditional headers present in a command against the current entity tag, throwing exceptions if conditions are unmet.

methods.name: skipPreconditionHeaderCheck
methods.description: Determines whether to skip the precondition header validation based on command category, current entity tag, and an additional predicate.

methods.name: checkIfMatch
methods.description: Checks the If-Match header in the command and throws an exception if the current ETag does not meet the condition.

methods.name: checkIfNoneMatch
methods.description: Checks the If-None-Match header and throws an exception or Not Modified response as appropriate.

methods.name: buildPreconditionFailedException
methods.description: Constructs an exception to indicate precondition failed, with details about the header and current entity tag.

methods.name: buildNotModifiedException
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating that the resource was not modified.

methods.name: appendETagIfNotNull
methods.description: Adds the current ETag to the headers if it is not null.
